title: Patron Class Terms for Discounted Early Retirement of Capital Credits
content:
# Discounted Early Retirement — Patron Class Terms

**Product:** Capital Credits (Patronage Capital). A former member whose capital account in a class is inactive may, where the class offers it, ask for the class's credits to be retired early at a discount.

| Patron class | Discounted early retirement offered | Annual early retirement discount rate | Full calendar months inactive before a request | Smallest unretired balance accepted | Request window each year | Dissolved business or organization retired early |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential Patron Class | Yes | 7.5 percent | 12 | $100.00 | September 1 (09-01) through October 31 (10-31) | No |
| Seasonal Patron Class | Yes | 7.5 percent | 12 | $100.00 | 09-01 through 10-31 | No |
| Farm Patron Class | Yes | 7.5 percent | 12 | $100.00 | 09-01 through 10-31 | No |
| General Service Patron Class | No | 7.5 percent | 12 | $100.00 | 09-01 through 10-31 | No |
| Irrigation Patron Class | No | 7.5 percent | 12 | $100.00 | 09-01 through 10-31 | No |
| Large Power Patron Class | No | 7.5 percent | 12 | $100.00 | 09-01 through 10-31 | No |

## Reading the schedule

- Only the Residential, Seasonal and Farm Patron Classes offer discounted early retirement. In the General Service, Irrigation and Large Power Patron Classes the remaining columns are listed for completeness, but no discounted early retirement is offered.
- The request window opens on September 1 and closes on October 31 of each year, both days included; requests are approved with that year's general retirement.
- In no class is a dissolved business or organization retired early; its credits stay in the general rotation.

## Hypothetical boundary cases (Farm Patron Class)

| Unretired balance | Request date | Within the minimum and the window |
|---|---|---|
| $100.00 | September 1 | Yes |
| $99.99 | September 15 | No — below $100.00 |
| $450.00 | October 31 | Yes |
| $450.00 | November 1 | No — outside the window |
| $450.00 | August 31 | No — outside the window |
